trello.name: Build Stripe Elements checkout form
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Implement the frontend checkout process using Stripe Elements. Style the checkout form to match the app's design (clean and straightforward). Handle potential errors gracefully, such as invalid card details or insufficient funds. Ensure the checkout button is prominent. Deadline: within the next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Update pricing page with subscription tiers
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Update the pricing page to reflect the three new subscription tiers: Basic ($29/month, basic AI model selection tool access, limited features), Pro ($49/month, additional features, priority support), and Enterprise ($99/month, all features, custom support, integration options). Include a clear comparison of features for each tier and a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if the user chooses a different plan later on. Deadline: within the next two weeks.

trello.name: Build user dashboard subscription management
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Build the user dashboard to include: current plan details and billing info; options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription; access to invoices and payment history; ability to update payment methods. Dashboard should be intuitive, reflect current subscription status in real-time, and notify users of changes such as successful plan upgrades or payment failures. Deadline: within the next two weeks.

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend subscription API
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Once Taylor has the backend set up, integrate the frontend with the API. Ensure any changes to the subscription are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Handle errors during integration and provide clear notifications to users (e.g., clear messaging and instructions if a payment fails). Coordinate with Taylor to ensure frontend matches backend. Deadline: within the next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Handle user notifications for subscription events
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Implement user-facing notifications for different subscription events, including subscription confirmations and payment errors. Ensure notifications are clear and provide instructions where applicable (e.g., how to fix a failed payment). Deadline: within the next two weeks.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to handle all subscription-related tasks: creating and managing subscriptions (when a user selects a plan and completes payment), processing payments (handling successful and failed payments), and managing webhooks for events like invoice payment success/failure and subscription cancellations. Deadline: within the next two weeks (initial integration).

trello.name: Set up Stripe webhook event handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Implement webhook handlers for the following events: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm successful payments and activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users of failed payments, prompt them to update payment info, and send an email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (update access rights and offer chance to re-subscribe). Ensure handlers update the system correctly. Deadline: within the next two weeks.

trello.name: Prepare and share subscription test plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests, including test scenarios to simulate different webhook events (e.g., payment failures, cancellations). The plan should cover the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription. Share the test plan with Alex and Jordan. Testing phase occurs in the week following the initial two-week integration period; all edge cases must be covered.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhook handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make future maintenance and troubleshooting easier. Deadline: ongoing, should be available alongside the integration.

trello.name: Create user documentation and help section for subscriptions
trello.desc: Owner: Team (unassigned). Once everything is live, create clear user-facing instructions on how to manage subscriptions, access invoices, and handle issues. Include a help section or FAQ covering common issues and questions about subscriptions. Deadline: after the integration and testing phases are complete.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up progress review meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe subscription integration and address any issues or blockers that come up. Team members should reach out if they run into blockers before the meeting.
